intent: A creator improving a skill from a batch gets several alternative suggestion sets in one round, each looking at a different part of the package, without paying more than the operator allows.
observable_outcome: With K candidates set, one POST reflections makes K focused model calls, returns each candidate's focus, outcome and suggestions, and is debited once; it is refused before any call when no round cap is set or the estimate exceeds the cap.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A round is admitted once before its first model call and debited once for the usage summed over the calls that answered; a round with no answered call is not charged.

A round asking for more than one candidate is refused with 409 naming reflection_round_credit_cap while no cap is set, and with 422 when the start threshold times the candidates exceeds the cap or the balance.

Each candidate's focus and outcome are recorded in order, each suggestion carries its candidate index, and the round's outcome is the best of its candidates'; a round of one candidate records no candidates.
